name: USC Marshall School of Business, University of Southern California

tuition_total.basis: first-year tuition 86,295 + second-year tuition 78,450 as published by the school (estimate on 2026-27 rates; school warns of 3-5% yearly increases)

mandatory_fees_total.basis: USC central services and health fees 1,922 + 1,844; MBA program fees 3,000 + 400; PRIME fee 3,850 (year 1); student health insurance 3,988 + 3,787 (waivable)

living_budget_total.note: Marshall's tuition page excludes housing and living costs; USC Financial Aid's graduate cost of attendance is served by an interactive tool not readable without a browser (https://financialaid.usc.edu/graduate-professional-financial-aid/cost-of-attendance/)

scholarship.type: merit awards, automatic consideration at admission; Consortium, ROMBA and Schoen veterans fellowships

employment.employed_3m_note: 71% employed within 90 days of graduation (school's class profile page); no detailed CSEA report found online
employment.by_industry_note: Average starting salary by industry shown without class shares; cohort label not explicit next to these four figures (shown above the Class of 2025 outcomes block)
employment.top_employers_note: 'Representative employers' list (alphabetical, no counts); excerpt of a longer list

profile.gmat_note: school publishes average GMAT 742 (edition not stated), average GRE 322
